Shipping policy: free over $40 from December

November 26, 2026

From December 1, 2026 every Harbor Lights order over $40 ships free within the continental United States. Orders under $40 pay a $6 flat rate. Alaska and Hawaii keep the $8 flat rate, and subscription orders ship free at any size, as before.

Orders placed before noon Pacific ship the same day from Portland, Austin or Denver, whichever roastery is nearest; whole-bean orders are roasted within 48 hours of shipping.
